parameters.query:
SELECT 
  status,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM contacts 
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY count DESC;

SELECT 
  first_name, last_name, email, company, title, phone,
  status, follow_up_count, replied, needs_call, call_done,
  last_email_sent_at, replied_at, notes
FROM contacts 
WHERE needs_call = true AND call_done = false
ORDER BY replied_at ASC NULLS LAST, last_email_sent_at ASC;

SELECT 
  first_name, last_name, email, company, status, follow_up_count, last_email_sent_at
FROM contacts 
WHERE status IN ('new', 'emailed') AND replied = false
ORDER BY last_email_sent_at ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 20;
